title: Accept a dotted pass key in prose addresses
lead: `parse_ref` splits on every dot and requires three parts. `refs()` emits `pass.v1.1.heading` for the pass key `v1.1`, and `slicer prose list` exits 2 with an unknown-block error. The skill tells agents to run that command.
findings_note: slicer prose list exits 2 on this repo because pass v1.1 becomes pass.v1.1.heading
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing pass display order; renaming existing pass keys; accepting a field other than heading, intro, or outro.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The address form is `pass.<key>.<field>`, and the key is allowed to contain dots. Taking the last segment as the field keeps `pass.5.intro` working and makes `pass.v1.1.heading` work. The list command on this repo is the regression check.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `pass.v1.1.heading` parses as pass key `v1.1` and field `heading`. `pass.5.intro` still parses as key `5` and field `intro`.
2. An unknown last segment, or an empty key, is still an error and names the valid forms.
3. `slicer prose list` on this repo exits 0 and includes `pass.v1.1.heading`. `prose show` and `prose edit` accept that reference.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Parse the field from the last segment and the pass key from everything between the `pass` prefix and that field. Leave the valid field names as they are.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: The failing tests pass, then `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`, `slicer check`, and `git diff --check`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, including the re-rendered roadmap and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.
